statutes.title: Rates of Tax on Individuals
text_en: Imposes Virginia individual income tax at graduated rates: 2.0% on the first $3,000; 3.0% on $3,001 to $5,000; 5.0% on $5,001 to $17,000; and 5.75% on taxable income exceeding $17,000.
text_es: Impone el impuesto sobre la renta individual de Virginia con tasas graduadas: 2.0% sobre los primeros $3,000; 3.0% de $3,001 a $5,000; 5.0% de $5,001 a $17,000; y 5.75% sobre el exceso de $17,000.

statutes.title: Definitions - Resident and Actual Resident
text_en: Defines resident individual as one domiciled in Virginia, or an actual resident who maintains a place of abode and spends in the aggregate more than 183 days of the taxable year in Virginia.
text_es: Define individuo residente como quien tiene domicilio en Virginia, o un residente de hecho que mantiene morada y pasa más de 183 días en total del año contributivo en Virginia.

statutes.title: Reciprocal Tax Agreements for Commuters
text_en: Authorizes reciprocal agreements with contiguous jurisdictions (DC, Maryland, West Virginia, Pennsylvania, and Kentucky) exempting commuter compensation from non-resident withholding.
text_es: Autoriza acuerdos recíprocos de exención con jurisdicciones limítrofes (DC, Maryland, West Virginia, Pensilvania y Kentucky) para salarios devengados por viajeros diarios.
